messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Here’s a quick reference to the long‑weekend holidays in Canada for 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a statutory holiday that falls on a Friday or Monday (or a holiday that is observed on a Monday when it lands on a weekend).  

| Date | Day | Holiday | Notes |
|------|-----|---------|-------|
| **January 1** | Sunday | New Year’s Day | Observed on Monday, Jan 2 |
| **January 16** | Monday | Family Day (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Observed on Monday |
| **February 20** | Monday | Louis Riel Day (Manitoba) | Observed on Monday |
| **March 17** | Wednesday | St. Patrick’s Day (Ontario) | Not a statutory holiday |
| **April 7** | Monday | Good Friday | Observed on Monday |
| **April 10** | Thursday | Easter Monday (Quebec) | Observed on Thursday |
| **May 22** | Monday | Victoria Day | Observed on Monday |
| **June 19** | Monday | National Indigenous Peoples Day (British Columbia) | Observed on Monday |
| **July 1** | Saturday | Canada Day | Observed on Monday, July 3 |
| **August 7** | Monday | Civic Holiday (most provinces) | Observed on Monday |
| **September 18** | Monday | Labour Day | Observed on Monday |
| **October 9** | Monday | Thanksgiving (Canada) | Observed on Monday |
| **November 7** | Monday | Remembrance Day | Observed on Monday |
| **December 25** | Monday | Christmas Day | Observed on Monday |
| **December 26** | Tuesday | Boxing Day | Observed on Tuesday |

### Long‑Weekend Summary

| Long Weekend | Dates Covered | Total Days Off |
|--------------|---------------|----------------|
| New Year’s | Dec 31 – Jan 2 | 3 days |
| Family Day | Jan 13 – Jan 16 | 4 days |
| Louis Riel Day | Feb 17 – Feb 20 | 4 days |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 – Apr 10 | 4 days |
| Victoria Day | May 20 – May 22 | 3 days |
| National Indigenous Peoples Day | Jun 17 – Jun 19 | 3 days |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 – Jul 3 | 3 days |
| Civic Holiday | Aug 4 – Aug 7 | 4 days |
| Labour Day | Sep 15 – Sep 18 | 4 days |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 6 – Oct 9 | 4 days |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 4 – Nov 7 | 4 days |
| Christmas & Boxing | Dec 24 – Dec 26 | 3 days |

> **Tip for your app:**  
> - Use the `observed` dates for holidays that fall on weekends.  
> - Some provinces observe different holidays (e.g., Family Day in Alberta vs. Louis Riel Day in Manitoba).  
> - If you need province‑specific data, let me know and I can break it down further.

Let me know if you’d like the data in a CSV/JSON format or if you need additional details!
